programme.title: Tenebre
programme.desc: A writer arrives in Rome only to find that somebody is using his novels as the inspiration and occasionally the means of committing murder. As the death toll mounts the police are more and more baffled, and the writer becomes more closely linked to the case than is comfortable.

programme.title: Race For The Yankee Zephyr
programme.desc: In a lake high in the mountains of New Zealand, hunter Gibbie Gibson discovers a plane wreck from WW II. When word gets out, a gang of crooks follows and threatens him and his daughter, because they know there are 50 million dollars in the wreck. Helicopter pilot Barney helps the father and daughter out at the risk of his own life.

programme.title: Grave Of The Vampire

programme.desc: In the middle of the 16th century, Hideyoshi, a power hungry warlord sets out to destroy the Momochi clan.
